method: Every 3 hours we read token contracts and the wallets that hold locked allocations on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Base, Arbitrum and Avalanche through public RPC nodes. A wallet's role comes either from the project's own disclosure or from our analysis of holders and transfers (marked per wallet). Moves of 0.1% of supply or more are listed as events. Mint and burn on bridge copies of a token are ignored. Daily history starts on 28 Oct 2026. Since 29 Oct 2026, transfers out of tracked Ethereum, BNB Chain and Base wallets also show where the tokens went: another wallet of the same project, a smart contract, an exchange (only when the address is in the exchange's own published wallet list: OKX proof of reserves, KuCoin wallet list), an exchange via a deposit address (the recipient moved at least half of the tokens to such an exchange address within 7 days), or a wallet that passed the tokens on to 50 or more addresses within 7 days. Everything else is shown as 'address'. Each transfer links to its transaction.

BREV.finding: As of 28 Oct 2026: all locked supply (750M, 75%) sits in one upgradeable vesting contract with the schedule on-chain. About 168.8M (16.9% of supply) is already unlocked but has never been withdrawn, so it can be moved in a single transaction at any time. Next steps in the contract: +18.2M on 6 Nov and 6 Dec 2026, then about +31M per month from 6 Jan 2027. The contract owners (Safe multisigs) can change the schedule.
